provenance.purpose: Schema, tests, and interface development only

steps: Stand in a stable position and choose a comfortable stance.
Descend under control while keeping the feet supported.
Stop for pain, loss of balance, or technique breakdown.
Return under control without forcing range of motion.
Use a stable surface that will not slide.
Lower only through a pain-free range.
Press away from the surface without locking into pain.
Set a stable support and a manageable load.
Keep the torso controlled without twisting for momentum.
Pull through a comfortable path and pause briefly.
Lower under control and stop if grip or posture fails.
